description: TRAI has tightened anti-spam rules by adding AI-based detection and requiring telecom operators to share suspected spam-number data. Caller ID apps must share spam reports via the DLT platform, while A2P calls require prior declaration and may face termination charges of up to 5 paise/minute.

description: Ashwini Vaishnaw said a number of Memorandums of Understanding and purchase orders had been finalised during SEMICON India 2026

description: Refiners are paying a premium of around $1 a barrel for Russian oil, while Brent crude prices of around $103 per barrel are also raising concerns over import costs.

description: Russia has proposed that India manufacture the Su-57 stealth fighter domestically, seeking a Su-30MKI-style partnership. While the IAF needs just 36-54 jets, Russia wants a 100-aircraft commitment to achieve economies of scale. India must weigh this against its indigenous AMCA fighter programme.

description: Indian Railways plans to launch second sleeper Vande Bharat Express, connecting New Delhi and Varanasi. The overnight service aims to reduce travel time and enhance comfort, with a trial run expected this month and operations starting around Diwali. The trial run is likely to take place this month.

title: India mulls doubling port contract tenures to spur private investment
description: The aim is to provide investors greater certainty and a longer recovery window for their upfront and future investments, thereby reducing risk perception and improving bankability of projects.

description: Homebuyers in Ahmedabad, Chennai, and Delhi-NCR prefer larger homes, especially 3BHKs, according to ANAROCK's H1 2026 survey. The  ₹90 lakh– ₹1.5 crore price range is most favoured, reflecting a shift towards premium housing despite rising prices, with many buyers prioritising space and quality.

description: A document circulating on social media claimed that the central government had notified a scheme for the amalgamation of Public Sector Banks. It is fake.

title: Jaggery prices climb as consumers seek a natural alternative to refined sugar
description: India is the world's largest producer of jaggery and accounts for more than 70% of the global output of around 13 million tonnes annually. Traditionally used in Indian households and food preparations, jaggery is increasingly being positioned as a healthier alternative to refined sugar.

description: India's new UPI fee could create a  ₹270 billion annual revenue pool by FY28, with banks expected to capture the biggest share. SBI, Axis Bank and Yes Bank are among those likely to benefit as charges on larger UPI transactions begin from October 15.

Audiences now favour authentic storytelling, aided by social media and expanded distribution, making regional cinema a significant player in the theatrical landscape.

description: Indians have led Deutsche Bank and Citigroup to Barclays yet at home, the likes of HDFC Bank to Kotak Mahindra Bank can face a string of challenges finding CEOs.

description: Banks could gain  ₹70–100 crore in quarterly revenue from the reintroduction of UPI MDR, with larger lenders potentially earning nearly three times more. The 0.4% fee on select transactions above  ₹2,000 may also boost card payments and support UPI’s long-term financial sustainability.

description: Barc is looking to take its 300 MW nuclear reactor module to commercial scale with private-sector participation. If viable, the reactor could account for 30 GW of India’s targeted 100 GW nuclear capacity by 2047.

title: Delhi, Maharashtra, Karnataka top NITI Aayog's 2025 index for states' electric mobility transition
description: The top-performing states retained their leading positions from last year as the overall median score improved to 40 from 36.

description: The introduction of a 0.4% fee on UPI transactions above  ₹2,000 is shrinking shopkeepers' net profits right before the peak festival shopping period. While large stores plan to absorb the cost or split bills, trade groups warn small retailers may reduce discounts or favour cash payments.

title: Petrol dealers seek exemption from new charges on UPI transactions
description: Fuel retailers say thin, regulated margins leave little room to absorb the  ₹5 charge on UPI transactions above  ₹2,000.

description: MDR on UPI payments is not expected to significantly impact overall transaction volumes, given that only 4% of total UPI transactions are expected to be eligible for such a charge. However, the charge has created a lot of noise around its potential impact on UPI usage
